replies.author: Legoche
replies.body: The layout is pretty basic but if the islands were made bigger and the mounuments were in a better spot the map could work. Diamonds and Enchants don't work together - thats a big no no, don't do it. The iron islands should be on the spawn island and there should be more of it. The back monument at the moment is pretty impossible to push. Overall, the layout is pretty basic but with changes it could be better :)
